title: PI objectives — tranche 4 (retrospective, authorised 2026-11-22)
body:
# PI objectives — tranche 4

## Objectives

1. **Every tr4 project closes on a green manifest.** The tranche's own gate.
2. **The factory records exist for every project.** The change-control row and document, the
   frozen baseline and the Phase-G compliance review — the std-* P0 packages cleared by rows,
   not by prose.
3. **The closure chain becomes replayable.** `projects.close_request`, `approvals.request`,
   `projects.close` and the card receipt/move actions join the promotion grammar, with T13's
   and T10's closure inputs as the replay corpus.
4. **No stale P0 card blocks a close.** A resolved finding or a published plan is receipted on
   its card and delivered; the sweep runs for every project before its close.

## Business value

Objectives 1–2 discharge the tranche gate and the audit's P0 packages — the programme's
evidence bar; objective 3 makes the record promotable without a second writing pass;
objective 4 unblocks the factory without inventing work.

## Measurement

| Objective | Measure |
|---|---|
| 1 | `verify-project.py --project <KEY>` exit 0 at one snapshot |
| 2 | `audit-programme-conformance.py --rework-check std-…:<KEY>` cleared per package |
| 3 | `programme-record.py --check` green with the extended grammar; the closure kinds replay |
| 4 | the card transcript shows the comment and the intake→active→done moves per card |

## Evidence

The snapshot and its `_sqlx_migrations` head recorded in every evidence file; the published PI
plan and objectives (this document); the closure reviews and gates; the card transcripts under
`docs/evidence/rework/<KEY>/transcript.jsonl`.
